subject: Geopolitics
title: The Grain Weapon
description: A fast breakdown of The Grain Weapon for builders.

hook.text: Russia and Ukraine together export a quarter of the world's wheat. When war hit, global bread prices soared.

buildup.text: Food exports give producers leverage. Restricting grain shipments can starve populations on other continents.

discovery.text: During the Cold War the US used grain sales to the USSR as diplomatic leverage. Bushels became bargaining chips.

twist.text: The 2022 Ukraine blockade triggered food crises in Egypt, Somalia, and Yemen — nations far from the battlefield.

climax.text: Food insecurity drives migration, unrest, and regime change. The Arab Spring began with a bread price spike.

punchline.text: Hunger topples governments faster than armies.

quiz.question: How did the 2022 Ukraine war affect global food security?
options: It had no measurable impact on food prices
The grain blockade triggered crises in food-importing nations
It only affected European food supplies
